"Soft" RAM usage limit in bytes for a specific container.
If usage goes over the high boundary, the processes are throttled and put under reclaim pressure.

Max RAM usage limit in bytes per container (The container process will be terminated if the memory-max value is smaller than the container memory-current)
starting 7.23, this parameter cannot be set lower than 1MB, to avoid a situation where the container is terminated too early in the startup process

Global "soft" RAM usage limit in bytes for a specific container.
If usage goes over the high boundary, the processes are throttled and put under reclaim pressure.

Global max RAM usage limit in bytes per container (The container process will be terminated if the memory-max value is smaller than the container memory-current)
starting 7.23, this parameter cannot be set lower than 1MB, to avoid a situation where the container is terminated too early in the startup process
